description: Solve proportions of the form a:b = c:d. Pick which value is unknown (x) and get the answer instantly with the cross-multiplication steps shown.

faqs.a: A proportion states that two ratios are equal, written a:b = c:d or a/b = c/d. If three of the four values are known, the fourth is found by cross-multiplication.
In a/b = c/d, multiplying both sides to clear the fractions gives a*d = b*c. Rearranging for the unknown gives, for example, d = (b*c)/a.

faqs.q: Can any of the four values be the unknown?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose which of a, b, c or d is unknown and enter the other three. The solver applies the correct rearranged formula for each case.

faqs.q: What if a denominator is zero?
faqs.a: A proportion with b = 0 or d = 0 is undefined, so the tool will ask you to enter non-zero values for the denominators.

howto: Choose which value (a, b, c or d) is the unknown x.
The missing value is calculated instantly by cross-multiplication.
Read the step-by-step working to see exactly how the answer was found.
title: Proportion Solver
